mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_nm, m.url, m.parent_id, p.menu_nm AS parent_nm, m.sort_no, m.icon, m.use_yn, (SELECT STRING_AGG(mr.role_cd, ',') FROM gw_menu_role mr WHERE mr.menu_id = m.menu_id) AS role_csv FROM gw_menu m LEFT JOIN gw_menu p ON p.menu_id = m.parent_id ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.menu_id

SELECT m.menu_id, m.menu_nm, m.url, m.parent_id, p.menu_nm AS parent_nm, m.sort_no, m.icon, m.use_yn, (SELECT STRING_AGG(mr.role_cd, ',') FROM gw_menu_role mr WHERE mr.menu_id = m.menu_id) AS role_csv FROM gw_menu m LEFT JOIN gw_menu p ON p.menu_id = m.parent_id WHERE m.menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_menu (menu_nm, url, parent_id, sort_no, icon, use_yn) VALUES (#{menuNm}, #{url}, #{parentId}, COALESCE(#{sortNo}, 0), #{icon}, COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y'))
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_menu SET menu_nm = #{menuNm}, url = #{url}, parent_id = #{parentId}, sort_no = COALESCE(#{sortNo}, sort_no), icon = #{icon}, use_yn = COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn) WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
mapper.select: SELECT role_cd FROM gw_menu_role WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY role_cd
